findings.finding: The pointed arch hardly reads. At 1x the head of the frame looks like a flat lintel with chamfered corners, so the Gothic arch the brief asks for is lost.
findings.fix: Raise the frame's centre 2px above its shoulders. Step the inner dark opening up 1px per column toward the middle so the top edge comes to a peak. Put a 1px light keystone pixel at the apex.

findings.finding: The top two lit treads are 1px cream lines on near-black. At 1x they read slightly as ladder rungs or blinds rather than tread planes.
findings.fix: Make the uppermost lit tread 2px tall: the light row plus one mid-tone row under it. Lighten the dark gap between the two top treads by one palette step so the area reads as a lit landing.

findings.finding: At 1x the north balustrade, with its regularly spaced balusters over horizontal dark bands, reads a little like a floor grate or vent. The stairwell reading depends on the 4x view.
findings.fix: Widen the baluster gaps to 2px and drop 2 of the balusters. Put a 1px dark cast shadow on the top tread directly under the north rail. Lighten the southmost tread by one more step so the depth gradient starts brighter.

findings.finding: The south lip is a full-width light bar that is close in value to the side rails. At a glance it could be taken for a closing rail on the entry side.
findings.fix: Darken the lip's lower edge to the floor-outline colour and keep only its top row light. Notch 1px at each end where the side rails stop, so the rails visibly end above the lip.

findings.finding: The oak steps in the bottom row are nearly identical alternating bands. The tread/riser contrast is weaker than on the castle stair, so the lowest steps look a little like stacked planks.
findings.fix: On each bottom-row step, make the tread top row one step lighter (highlight) and the riser two steps darker. Add a 1px darker shadow line under each nosing.

findings.finding: The flared newels/handrails in the bottom row are a little wider than the frame, so the piece's outline bulges onto the floor next to the bookshelf feet.
findings.fix: Pull the outer handrail pixels in by 1px on each side so they line up with the frame posts. Keep a 1px dark floor shadow under the newel caps.

findings.finding: The white dropping and yellow straw pixels are high-contrast single pixels in the middle of the steps. At 1x they read as noise or sparkle rather than debris.
findings.fix: Darken the dropping to the light-grey tone and give it a 1px shadow pixel beneath. Shift the straw from bright yellow to the darker ochre step and make it a 2px diagonal.

findings.finding: The wooden rail box with dense vertical spindles reads a bit like a crate or cage at 1x. The dark interior has fewer tread bands than the castle version.
findings.fix: Remove every other spindle on the north rail. Add 1 more mid-dark tread band near the south so the descent gradient has 4 visible steps. Put a 1px shadow under the north rail.

places.finding: Clock tower: the new stair at the west end of the north wall sits tight against the remaining tool rack and the west pillar. The doorway frame's iron posts nearly touch the rack, so the wall feels crowded at 1x.
places.fix: Shift the remaining tool rack 1 cell east, or remove its leftmost 2px of overhang, so there is at least 2px of plain wall between the stair frame and the rack.

places.finding: Owlery: the down stairwell at (1,8) is flush against the west wall. Its west rail merges with the wall's light trim, so that side's outline is hard to read.
places.fix: Darken the west rail's outer column by one step, or add a 1px dark gap column between the west wall trim and the rail.
